name: OmaSession
author: brenoperucchi
description: Reopens the windows you had open, on the workspaces they were on, after a reboot or a crash -- speaking the Lua IPC that Hyprland 0.56 actually accepts.

barWidget.description: Session state: what was captured, when, and what came back

schema.label: Snapshot interval (seconds)
schema.description: How stale the session may be after a power loss. hyprresume defaults to 120; a crash-prone machine wants less.

schema.label: Let browsers reopen their own tabs
schema.description: Launches the browser once and places the windows it reopens. Off means empty windows on the right workspaces.
